title: Your first pull request
concept: Push a branch, open a PR

story.speaker: Ada
story.text: Now push your branch and open a Pull Request (PR).

items.text: Push the branch and open a PR

hints: A pull request asks others to review your branch before merging.
Push your branch, then open a PR on GitHub to propose the change.
Answer the question about pull requests.

questions.prompt: What does a Pull Request do?

choices.text: Asks the team to review and merge your branch

questions.explanation: A PR is a request to merge your branch into main.

recap: Push your branch and open a PR to get your code reviewed.
